No longer inherits from Hash in Rails 5.1+

Broad bare-name flag: `is_a?(Hash)` returns FALSE for ActionController::Parameters in Rails 5.1+ (Parameters no longer inherits from Hash). Audit each hit; safe when the receiver is a non-params Hash, broken when the receiver came from `params` / `.permit` / nested params indexing. Replace with `is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)`, duck-type via `respond_to?(:permit)` or `respond_to?(:each_pair)`, or restructure to drop the type check. Will produce false positives on local-variable Hashes.
